name: Falcon 9 Block 5 | Bandwagon 3 (Dedicated Mid-Inclination Rideshare)
description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a mid-inclination orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers.

landing.description: The Falcon 9 first stage B1090 has landed back at the launch site after its 3rd flight.
